Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (1 health test skipped — demo user has no source_connections seeded so the health payload path is only exercised through code review; connections endpoint attaches health via _connection_health per code). ONE BUG FOUND — suggestion chip click does not submit the question (stale closure).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a suggestion chip fills the input but does NOT submit — POST /api/ask/all is never fired. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/components/GlobalAskModal.jsx:121 uses `onClick={() => { setQ(s); setTimeout(submit, 20); }}` but `submit` is a closure that reads `q` from React state at render time. After setQ(s), the component hasn't re-rendered yet, so submit's closure still sees q='' and returns early at `if (question.length < 3 || asking) return;`. Fix: call submit with an explicit value, e.g. `const submit = async (override) => { const question = (override ?? q).trim(); ... }` and `onClick={() => { setQ(s); submit(s); }}`. Requirement in the review request: 'clicking a suggestion chip inside the ask modal also submits the question'.

action_items: Fix GlobalAskModal.jsx suggestion-chip stale closure — pass the chosen string into submit() directly instead of relying on state update + setTimeout.

rca of the issue: GlobalAskModal.jsx line 121: `onClick={() => { setQ(s); setTimeout(submit, 20); }}`. Because `submit` is defined inline in the component body, its closure captures the current render's `q` (which is ''). setQ(s) schedules a re-render, but the setTimeout fires the previously-captured `submit` reference whose `q` is still '' — `question.trim().length < 3` short-circuits and the fetch is never issued. Reproducible 100%: open Ask modal → click any chip → input fills, but no POST /api/ask/all is sent. Mitigation: `const submit = async (override) => { const question = (typeof override === 'string' ? override : q).trim(); ... }` and `onClick={() => { setQ(s); submit(s); }}`.
